title: BlackBerry Ltd (BBRY) Is the Next Nvidia Corporation (NVDA). What?
主要内容: BlackBerry Ltd (BBRY) shares rose 9% after Citron Research suggested the company could follow a similar trajectory to Nvidia Corporation (NVDA). Citron highlighted BBRY's potential for growth, noting that NVDA's enterprise value increased from $5 billion to $85 billion in two years. BlackBerry has shifted its focus from hardware to software licensing, emphasizing its QNX platform as a key player in securing autonomous vehicles. The platform is described as 'at the forefront of securing cars for autonomous driving technology.' Despite losing money for at least four years, BBRY beat revenues for the first time in five quarters, with a net income loss of $47 million, its smallest loss over the past five quarters. Earnings per share were flat or positive over the past four quarters. Securities explicitly mentioned in the source include Apple Inc. (AAPL), Ford Motor Company (F), GM.
